## Functions

### `buildProfile(id, scan, opts = {})`

Build a full profile from a static scan result.

**Parameters:**

- `id` *(string)* — _No description in source JSDoc._
- `[opts]` *(object)* — — { sourceType, sourceHash, liveSource }

### `mergeProfiles(saved, fresh)`

Merge a saved profile with a freshly scanned one. Saved healing/permissions decisions win (they were promoted as working); newly detected requirements and `uses`/`gpu` flags are unioned in.

### `profilePermissionList(profile)`

Map a profile to a kernel/AppRegistry permission list (best-effort).

### `async sha256Hex(str)`

SHA-256 hex of a string (used for source/version hashing).

## Constants

- `PROFILE_FORMAT` — profile-builder.js — assemble & merge compatibility profiles. A profile is the durable description of what a guest app needs and how to heal it. The static scanner produces a fresh profile; the cache may hold a saved one from a previous version. `mergeProfiles` reuses known-good healing decisions and layers in newly detected requirements.
